Content: In some windy locations, a group of wind turbines may be built near each other. These are known as wind farms. Which pair of statements best describes a disadvantage and an advantage of building a wind farm instead of a `text(single)` wind turbine?

A.Choice:
`bbtext(Disadvantage)`: A wind farm uses more nonrenewable energy than a `text(single)` wind turbine uses.
`bbtext(Advantage)`: A wind farm can be built close to towns that need electricity.

B.Choice:
`bbtext(Disadvantage)`: A wind farm produces less electricity than a `text(single)` wind turbine produces.
`bbtext(Advantage)`: A wind farm can easily be built in locations far from birds.

C.Choice:
`bbtext(Disadvantage)`: A wind farm is more dangerous to birds than a `text(single)` wind turbine.
`bbtext(Advantage)`: A wind farm produces enough sound to keep birds away.

D.Choice:
`bbtext(Disadvantage)`: A wind farm produces more noise pollution than a `text(single)` wind turbine produces.
`bbtext(Advantage)`: A wind farm produces a greater amount of electricity than a `text(single)` wind turbine produces.

Content: Deforestation is the clearing or removal of forest land for use by humans for other purposes. Deforestation is common in areas that are used to raise cattle and grow crops. Which set of information describes the `text(best)` way humans could reduce this impact on the environment?

A.Choice:
`bbtext(Proposal)`: Make new products by recycling parts of the trees that are removed.
`bbtext(Explanation)`: This proposal would decrease the amount of forest land used for cattle and crops.

B.Choice:
`bbtext(Proposal)`: Make new products by recycling the parts of trees that are removed.
`bbtext(Explanation)`: This proposal would decrease the amount of trash placed in landfills every `text(year)`.

C.Choice:
`bbtext(Proposal)`: Reduce the consumption of meat and dairy products.
`bbtext(Explanation)`: This proposal would increase the amount of forest land used for cattle and crops.

D.Choice:
`bbtext(Proposal)`: Reduce the consumption of meat and dairy products.
`bbtext(Explanation)`: This proposal would increase the amount of trash placed in landfills every `text(year)`.

Students in a science class set up an investigation to model soil formation by following the steps listed below.

:ibox:`bbtext(Investigation Steps)`

• Place `text(four)` cubes of sugar into a glass jar and place a lid on the jar.
• Shake the jar for `30` `text(seconds)`.
• Record observations about how the sugar cubes have changed.
• Shake the jar for `text(two)` more `text(minutes)`.
• Record observations about how the sugar cubes have changed.
Which observations were `text(most likely)` made, and which research question were the students `text(most likely)` testing during this investigation?

A.Choice:
`bbtext(Observation 1)`: The cubes broke down into smaller chunks.
`bbtext(Observation 2)`: The smaller chunks broke down into a powder.

B.Choice:
`bbtext(Observation 1)`: The cubes became larger as particles moved closer together.
`bbtext(Observation 2)`: The cubes broke down into smaller chunks.
`bbtext(Research Question)`: How does chemical weathering of rock produce soils?

C.Choice:
`bbtext(Observation 1)`: The cubes broke down into smaller chunks.
`bbtext(Observation 2)`: The smaller chunks broke down into a powder.
`bbtext(Research Question)`: How does physical weathering of rock produce soils?

D.Choice:
`bbtext(Observation 1)`: The cubes became larger as particles moved closer together.
`bbtext(Observation 2)`: The cubes broke down into smaller chunks.
`bbtext(Research Question)`: How does physical weathering of rock produce soils?
